data.description:
## Context / Problem

Discovered during the RCA of bug 9507-4676-27af-4344 (stub experiment E3). Commit e1352535ace (ticket dd41-239d-6e09-4a86) correctly lets an evidence-claimed model response execute ALL of its batched governed reads, but it also removed the only in-band pressure toward interleaved COMMITs: pre-dd41, every extra batched call returned COMMIT_STEERING_NOTICE ('...make the next response's single action a record_criterion_verdict COMMIT when due'); post-dd41 a batched read returns its plain result. Observed consequence on the live bedrock arm: the model gathers all evidence in ~2 batched responses and defers every record to the end, so the criterion bank is EMPTY for the whole evidence phase. The per-criterion fail-closed boundary (max_evidence_responses=3 in src/rebar/llm/completion_tool_policy.py:111) still guarantees progress against a persistent searcher, and batching reduces request consumption (dd41 measured run steps 9.5->7.0), so exhaustion-before-first-bank is structurally unlikely - this is a narrow latent exposure, not an active defect.

## Approach

Evaluate (with a stub replay plus one live trial) whether wrap_completion_evidence_policy should append a lightweight commit-due notice to the LAST result of a batched evidence response once the current criterion has accrued >=2 evidence responses, nudging an interleaved record without suppressing execution. If the measured zero-bank window is acceptable, close as accepted-risk with the measurement attached.

## Scope

- src/rebar/llm/completion_tool_policy.py (only if the nudge is adopted)
- tests/unit/test_completion_tool_policy.py (nudge contract, if adopted)

## Testing

Stub replay comparing zero-bank window with and without the nudge; the existing unit suite guards no-regression of the batching execution semantics.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A recorded decision (comment on this ticket) with stub-replay evidence: adopt the nudge or accept the risk, including the measured zero-bank window in evidence responses.
- [ ] If adopted: the nudge lands with unit coverage and the live 0707 eval stays green; if accepted: this ticket closes with the rationale and no code change.
data.title: Decide whether batched evidence responses need a commit-due nudge
